content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The set-read rule maps change ids to commit ids, batches the owning commits' documents, and names two fallbacks; the license check reads the crossing invariant, the single-document read and its fallback role, the change-id identity, the path derivation, and the process boundary, and names any element the rule contradicts. Review form: the criterion is applied to the rule's text; nothing runs.
